allot.subject: Monitoring Agency Report
allot.text: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026 - Funds raised through issue of Qualified Institutional Placement ( QIP )

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Rights Issue Committee Meeting held on Wednesday September 30, 2026.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Conversion of partly paid-up Rights Equity Shares into fully paid-up equity shares in relation to the rights issue by the Company, upon receipt of the Call Monies, as applicable'.

allot.subject: Qualified Institutional Placement
allot.text: Allotment of Equity Shares to all Eligible Qualified Institutional Buyers.

allot.subject: Qualified Institutional Placement
allot.text: Intimation regarding approval of closure of QIPs and Placement documents

allot.subject: Qualified Institutional Placement
allot.text: Intimation regarding Qualified Institutional Placement of equity shares of face value ₹1 each of the Company

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome Of Rights Issue Committee Meeting Held On Wednesday, May 13, 2026

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation for allotment of equity shares pursuant to the Composite Scheme of Amalgamation '.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Conversion Of Partly Paid-Up Rights Equity Shares Into Fully Paid-Up Equity Shares In Relation To The Rights Issue ('Rights Issue') By Adani Enterprises Limited (The 'Company'), Upon Receipt Of The Call Monies, As Applicable, Through Modes Other Than The ASBA Facility'.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Meeting of Management Committee for Allotment of shares in accordance with the Composite Scheme'.

allot.subject: Record Date
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange that the Record date for the purpose of Allotment of equity shares of the Company in accordance with the Composite Scheme is 14-Apr-2026.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Conversion Of Rs. 0.75 Partly Paid-Up Equity Shares Into Rs. 1.00 Fully Paid-Up Equity Shares In Relation To The Rights Issue By Adani Enterprises Limited, Upon Receipt Of The Payment In Respect Of The Second And Final Call Through The ASBA Facility, To The Extent Applicable'.

allot.subject: Committee Meeting Updates
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Rights Issue Committee Meeting held on February 09, 2026.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation For Conversion Of Rs. 0.50 Partly Paid-Up Equity Shares Into Rs. 0.75 Partly Paid-Up Equity Shares In Relation To The Rights Issue, Upon Receipt Of The Payment In Respect Of The First Call, To The Extent Applicable'.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding outcome of rights issue committee meeting held on December 17, 2025.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Allotment of partly paid up equity shares on rights basis

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'closure of the issue period of the rights issue of Adani Enterprises Limited '.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding submission of Letter of Offer dated November 12, 2025 for Rights Issue of Partly Paid up equity shares.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange that the Rights Issue Committee of the Board at its meeting held on November 11, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 3 : 25, i.e 3 Equity Shares for every 25 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 1800 per share.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment Of Non-Convertible Debentures On Private Placement Basis.'.
